reply.summary: Novatir is a grieving exile from a bright sky-realm who carries a dimension-folding blade and hunts the profiteers of old wars. Novatir hides among research staff by day and fights with cold, patient fury by night.

feats.scene: Novatir slices a seam through the air and drags a squad of armoured raiders through it before the seam snaps shut.
Novatir stands unmoved as a collapsing bridge of fused metal buries her.

reply.summary: Ntureo grew up hiding in a tyrant's shadow, and her calm presence can ease the rage of the most savage warriors around her. Ntureo tends wounds with patient hands and quietly aids an underground rebellion.

feats.scene: Ntureo shoves a heavy iron gate off its hinges to free a captive woman.
Ntureo shrugs off a collapsing tunnel wall while shielding a wounded fighter.

reply.summary: Vaseo is a pale-haired swamp demon who turns unseen at will and commands the drowned victims offered to her. Vaseo spreads sickness quietly, and even powerful dealers in cursed bargains step aside when she appears.

feats.scene: Vaseo raises a whole flooded harbour crew from the mud and sends them to tear a pier apart.
Vaseo walks out of a burning chapel without a mark on her pale skin.

reply.summary: Aunserte is a sharp-eyed newspaper publisher who rebuilt a struggling paper in a new headquarters. Aunserte has no powers, only a nose for news and a stubborn work ethic.

feats.scene: Aunserte slaps a stack of proofs on the desk hard enough to silence the room.
Aunserte is knocked off her feet by a delivery cart and gets straight back up for the deadline.

reply.summary: Unntniu is a widowed inventor who built a flying harness that fires bursts of heating rays. Unntniu works day shifts as a hired hero, balancing patrols with raising three children.

feats.scene: Unntniu cooks a robber's getaway engine solid with one sustained burst from her harness.
Unntniu takes a thrown crate on her padded shoulder and keeps flying.

reply.summary: Teseani is a swaggering war goddess who delights in carnage and joins fellow battle-deities against rival warrior women. Teseani wields a blade with godly skill and cannot die of age, only of heavy violence.

feats.scene: Teseani drives her sword into a fortress hill and the whole ridge splits into rubble.
Teseani laughs through a bombardment that flattens the camp around her.

reply.summary: Numnuni is a furred, horned demon lord once worshipped by a desert people, and he rules a fiery underworld. Numnuni hounds wandering heroes and the wizards who side with them through sorcery.

feats.scene: Numnuni exhales a wave of hellfire that melts a cliff-side temple into glass.
Numnuni stands in the heart of a collapsing volcano and merely yawns.

reply.summary: Veoco is a poised spymaster who directs a network of agents from a domed hideout, reading minds to keep them safe. Veoco shuts it all down with grace when funding dries up, and then lunches with an old friend.

feats.scene: Veoco slams a heavy steel door on a pursuer in the corridor.
Veoco takes a stumble down a stone stairway and brushes off the dust.

reply.summary: Miraau is a young sea-dweller who studies in a coral-domed academy under a queen. Miraau breathes both air and water, and uses curiosity rather than muscle to solve problems.

feats.scene: Miraau drives a school of fish and a heavy kelp net into a smuggler's hull at speed.
Miraau rides out a pressure surge from a deep trench without losing his breath.

reply.summary: Reocelli is a red-eyed, hairless noblewoman of a star-devouring bloodline who commands a fleet of raiders. Reocelli was married off young to settle debts, and she has plotted against her father ever since.

feats.scene: Reocelli drains the light from a small moon, and its crust cracks apart.
Reocelli swims through the corona of a dying sun and steps out smiling.

reply.summary: Estniore is a pale, red-eyed street criminal who bends wood to his will and wraps it in razor-edged sheets of paper. Estniore dreams of a big reputation but keeps ending up bruised in a cell.

feats.scene: Estniore whips up a storm of paper blades that shreds a row of parked cars.
Estniore takes a beating from a speedster and stays on his feet for one more taunt.

reply.summary: Mitico is a teenager from a rough neighbourhood who gained a goofy older father figure through his mother's romance. Mitico speaks two languages, avoids dairy, and swings a bike chain when scared.

feats.scene: Mitico swings a bike chain at a startled stranger and misses by an inch.
Mitico tumbles off a fence and gets up complaining about his knee.

reply.summary: Nonas is a white-haired professional killer who works the back alleys and docks for pay. Nonas ends up on the wrong side of a family grudge.

feats.scene: Nonas fires a heavy pistol through a car door and drops the driver.
Nonas absorbs a brutal beating in a warehouse and keeps his composure.

reply.summary: Llaern is a mercenary and psychic consultant whose mind can lift and crush objects. Llaern learned as a child that his gift, joined with his sister's, can mend or destroy.

feats.scene: Llaern wrenches a parked van off the road with his mind and flattens it against a wall.
Llaern endures a rooftop fall cushioned only by his own mental grip on the air.

reply.summary: Sassorstu is a tall, sturdy rebel in a ruined world whose artificial heart works like a tiny reactor to shield his body from radiation. Sassorstu helps free a captive child from a cruel feline regime.

feats.scene: Sassorstu overloads his chest reactor to blast a locked gate off a prison wall.
Sassorstu wades through a radioactive crater that kills the guards chasing him.

reply.summary: Tonti is a quiet university student with a dabbling interest in the occult who runs with a mystic crew in a big port city. Tonti has little power of his own, but he meddles with forces he does not understand.

feats.scene: Tonti scratches out a ritual circle and a sudden gust throws a stool across the room.
Tonti survives a violent fall down a stairwell with a cracked rib.

reply.summary: Serran is a reluctant hired killer who apologises as he works and mourns a lost family. Serran uses a fearsome pulsing weapon to settle contracts as painlessly as he can.

feats.scene: Serran detonates a pulse that collapses a gatehouse roof onto a rival crew.
Serran takes a hard kick to the ribs, coughs once, and keeps talking.

reply.summary: Lannau is a haunted physician in a skull mask and long robes who wields a heavy two-handed scythe against old war criminals. Lannau grows sickened by his own vengeance and stumbles toward an apparent end.

feats.scene: Lannau swings his scythe through a carved oak door in one cut.
Lannau tumbles down a stone embankment and rises, robes torn.

reply.summary: Vacorter is a ruthless ex-soldier whose body leaks harsh radiation, which he channels from his palms through a protective suit. Vacorter fires blasts that burst like small bombs.

feats.scene: Vacorter lets loose a radiant blast that collapses a warehouse into slag.
Vacorter takes a point-blank cannon shell on his suit and sneers.

reply.summary: Cesri is a cold, reclusive scientist who secretly altered unborn children with experimental drugs and then raised some of them in isolation. Cesri hides behind several false names.

feats.scene: Cesri shoves a gurney across a lab to block a doorway.
Cesri survives a hard fall to the desert floor after being cast loose by his own creations.

reply.summary: Tostin is a resurrected sentinel with a mixture in his blood that knits flesh back together and keeps him nearly deathless. Tostin guards a hidden mask beneath a hotel and fights with a blade, though cold slows his healing.

feats.scene: Tostin cuts through a steel grate and an intruder's rifle in a single stroke.
Tostin is crushed under a falling chandelier and rises with his bones already mending.

reply.summary: Ranrasau is a smooth casino owner who has traded other people's souls to a demon of greed to stretch out his own life. Ranrasau throws lavish parties and summons the corpses of past victims when cornered.

feats.scene: Ranrasau calls up a mob of dead gamblers who smash a stage set to splinters.
Ranrasau shrugs off a heavy blow from a bouncer's stool and adjusts his cuffs.

reply.summary: Ntralra is a former code-breaker whose mind moves objects, kept in check by a helmet that tames the pain. Ntralra glides on a wingsuit and turns against the cult of killers who once trained him.

feats.scene: Ntralra hurls a shipping container across a yard with his mind.
Ntralra survives a savage beating and a long night in the cold wilderness.

reply.summary: Lante is an ambitious teenage inventor and cub reporter who left home to make his own way in a coastal city. Lante is willing to play rough to get ahead, yet he lends a hand to anyone who stays out of his way.

feats.scene: Lante shoves a rival's camera tripod aside to get the first shot.
Lante is thrown across a plaza by a rampaging fighter and walks away bruised.

reply.summary: Linlisam is a hospital psychiatrist whose mind snapped under possession by a lord of disorder, handing him a warped helm and a bag of strange abilities. Linlisam can slip through walls, grow huge, and hurl fear and force.

feats.scene: Linlisam swells to the size of a tower and brings a clinic wing down with one swing.
Linlisam walks out of a collapsing ward with the helm gleaming and no wound.

reply.summary: Nerau is a retired master assassin who swore off violence and now teaches self-defence in public parks. Nerau reluctantly returns to crime for money after being shut out of renting a proper studio.

feats.scene: Nerau snaps a wooden training post with one precise strike.
Nerau takes a pair of heavy blows and answers with a disarming throw.

reply.summary: Teltorsta is a fanged, yellow-eyed brawler who attacks a young crimefighter in a seaside city. Teltorsta is beaten without ever understanding who beat him.

feats.scene: Teltorsta bites through a leather strap and slams a thug into a wall.
Teltorsta takes a brutal kick to the jaw and charges anyway.

reply.summary: Leocolnum is a disciplined karate instructor and secret vigilante who hunts a fanatic cult with knife-studded knuckles. Leocolnum became a bogeyman whispered about among his enemies.

feats.scene: Leocolnum drives his blade-knuckles through a wooden barricade and into the man behind it.
Leocolnum fights on through a rain of blows in a cult cellar.

reply.summary: Ntern is a mid-ranking black-market arms dealer who is always trying to climb the underworld ladder. Ntern runs from trouble the moment a deal goes wrong.

feats.scene: Ntern slams a case of crates shut and hurries toward the exit.
Ntern shrugs off a bruising tackle and keeps running.

reply.summary: Natoncor is a patient burglar who spends months tunnelling into a hero base to steal its computers. Natoncor threatens to blow the whole building when cornered, but is caught off guard.

feats.scene: Natoncor rigs a charge in his tunnel that could bring down a wing of the headquarters.
Natoncor is hauled out of the dirt by guards and barely scratched.

reply.summary: Tunurn is a warm, flamboyant cabaret owner who becomes a fairy godparent to a lost teenager. Tunurn defends a beloved venue from a wave of developers with a baseball bat and sharp wit.

feats.scene: Tunurn cracks his bat across a bully's shin and the whole room goes quiet.
Tunurn is shoved into a stack of chairs and stands up sparkling.

reply.summary: Lisirti is a former gang bodyguard who becomes a masked night vigilante in a crowded harbour city to find his best friend's killer. Lisirti walks the line between justice and revenge.

feats.scene: Lisirti drops three henchmen with a spinning kick on a neon-lit rooftop.
Lisirti drops from a fire escape and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Coval is a legendary northern monster hunter with the strength of thirty men and a grip that never breaks. Coval carries blades and, oddly, a pair of pistols.

feats.scene: Coval hurls a longship's mast through a beast's chest.
Coval takes a monster's full lunge on his shield arm and holds his ground.

reply.summary: Nioll is a sixth-century warrior sent by a mysterious shaper through the underworld, a bog, and a sunken city to reach a fruit that can slay a monster. Nioll meets a gallery of legends on the way.

feats.scene: Nioll cleaves a labyrinth beast in half with a single mighty swing.
Nioll climbs out of a fiery pit with his armour smoking.

reply.summary: Nanential is an engineered super-soldier who slept for centuries in a hidden fortress before being woken to hunt a man-eating monster. Nanential is silent, swift, and enhanced in strength, sight, and smell.

feats.scene: Nanential tears through a hall of armed men and leaves a single survivor.
Nanential takes a ballista bolt in the shoulder and keeps fighting.

reply.summary: Nttare is a small, brown-furred space-born monkey with hero ambitions who lives in a big city. Nttare has the body of an alien species and wears a little cape.

feats.scene: Nttare flings a bus-sized boulder into orbit by accident while playing.
Nttare shakes off a falling skyscraper billboard as if it were confetti.

reply.summary: Anvaltir is a mischievous space-born monkey who stowed away on a rescue rocket and later turned up to cause trouble for a young hero. Anvaltir flies, hits hard, and is fast enough to leap through time, yet is weak to magic and a glowing mineral.

feats.scene: Anvaltir flings a boulder through a shipping crane and the dock collapses.
Anvaltir shrugs off a wrecking ball and a falling crane.
Anvaltir streaks across the sky and vanishes into the past.

reply.summary: Ilnanti is a brilliant monkey chemist who cures his friends of a virus, only to watch the cure fade. Ilnanti mourns a ruined world and fears his feral companions.

feats.scene: Ilnanti heaves a lab stool at a charging teammate and runs.
Ilnanti tumbles through a shelf of glassware and scrambles upright.

reply.summary: Neosst is a dark-haired deity from a bleak fire-pit world who keeps company with a stern warlord. Neosst has the vast durability and strength of her divine kind.

feats.scene: Neosst hammers the ground and levels a whole block of slums.
Neosst walks through a barrage of rockets in the burning streets.

reply.summary: Bernadeth is a hardened general in the cruel armies of a fiery world who sided with a scheming matron in a civil war. Bernadeth sees the conflict end abruptly when a dread overlord returns.

feats.scene: Bernadeth orders a barrage and personally flattens a trench line.
Bernadeth strides through burning wreckage without breaking stride.

reply.summary: Vanan is a hero who borrows the abilities of animals, reshaping parts of his body to match, and later falls in with a band of assassins. Vanan feels what animals feel, and he dies by a gunshot after a failed escape.

feats.scene: Vanan grows an ox's shoulders and flings a jeep through a hedge.
Vanan shifts to the hide of a rhino and stands against a gun battery.

reply.summary: Ontntte is an actor and animal-rights activist who dips into a hidden field of life to borrow any creature's power. Ontntte balances heroics with a loving family and relishes each thrill.

feats.scene: Ontntte takes on the strength of an elephant and the speed of a falcon to hurl a tanker truck over a bridge.
Ontntte takes the toughened hide of a beast and endures a collapsing overpass.

reply.summary: Onttera is a trainee from a family of wind-callers who dreams of joining a famous team of young heroes. Onttera whips up gusts and gales and studies at an academy on a rocky coast.

feats.scene: Onttera spins a storm of wind that rips the roof from a barn.
Onttera is knocked flat in a training bout and bounces back up laughing.

reply.summary: Tiaeon is a pink-haired, pale-skinned knight whose head was cut off centuries ago and who endures through magic. Tiaeon wears heavy armour and keeps a quiet watch over a castle city.

feats.scene: Tiaeon splits a stone gatepost with a single sword stroke.
Tiaeon picks up his own severed head and sets it back in place.

reply.summary: Tumiasmia is a bloodthirsty demon who has possessed many bodies over the centuries to carry out grisly murders, then hangs their portraits in a ruined chapel. Tumiasmia lures a mighty warrior into her trap to steal her body.

feats.scene: Tumiasmia screams and a whole chapel wall bursts outward in a rain of stone.
Tumiasmia stands unharmed amid a fiery collapse of her hideout.

reply.summary: Stistone is a gentle father and husband from a ringed-planet moon whose mind-reading gift runs in the family. Stistone raised daughters who would grow to be great heroes.

feats.scene: Stistone nudges an apple cart upright after a storm.
Stistone slips on an icy road and gets up laughing.

reply.summary: Resnania is a patient alien scientist who spent years tinkering on a captive monster to make it unkillable. Resnania is killed when his creation breaks free and keeps his skull as a trophy.

feats.scene: Resnania slams a lever and a restraint clamp locks shut on a thrashing beast.
Resnania is thrown across a lab bench and clings to a rail.
